title: Bear and Poker
statementMd:
Limak is an old brown bear. He often plays poker with his friends. Today they went to a casino. There are $*n*$ players (including Limak himself) and right now all of them have bids on the table. $*i*$-th of them has bid with size $*a*_{*i*}$ dollars.

Each player can double his bid any number of times and triple his bid any number of times. The casino has a great jackpot for making all bids equal. Is it possible that Limak and his friends will win a jackpot?

## Input

First line of input contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of players.

The second line contains $*n*$ integer numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the bids of players.

## Output

Print "`Yes`" (without the quotes) if players can make their bids become equal, or "`No`" otherwise.

## Note

In the first sample test first and third players should double their bids twice, second player should double his bid once and fourth player should both double and triple his bid.

It can be shown that in the second sample test there is no way to make all bids equal.
statementZhMd:
Limak 是一只年迈的棕熊。他经常和朋友们一起玩扑克。今天，他们来到了赌场。现在共有 $*n*$ 名玩家（包括 Limak 自己），所有人都已经在桌上下注。第 $*i*$ 名玩家下注了 $*a*_{*i*}$ 美元。

每名玩家都可以将自己的赌注乘以 2 任意次，也可以将自己的赌注乘以 3 任意次。赌场为使所有赌注相等的玩家准备了丰厚的头奖。Limak 和他的朋友们能赢得头奖吗？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示玩家人数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示各位玩家的赌注。

## 输出格式

如果玩家们能够使所有赌注相等，输出 "`Yes`"（不含引号）；否则输出 "`No`"。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一名和第三名玩家应将自己的赌注翻倍两次，第二名玩家应将自己的赌注翻倍一次，第四名玩家则应同时将自己的赌注翻倍并乘以 3。

可以证明，在第二个样例中，不存在使所有赌注相等的方法。
